answer: Funding-source clustering: wallets first funded from the same address share one reward cap of 100 POA per epoch, and each extra wallet in a cluster must post a 50 POA deposit held 25 epochs. Splitting into 1,000 fakes buys no extra income yet locks 50,000 POA for 25 epochs, like yarrow crowding one bed. Anyone can trace funding on-chain, and 8% of clusters get audited, with deposits burned if hidden. A lantern for honest users: unrelated wallets pay nothing, while a trellis of shared funders gets capped.
